name: four_sources

pipeline.tier_reason: every definition, action, transformation and method is traced: exhaustive over the four registries; the links themselves carry their own tiers

statement: The four sources: every algorithm and function has a definition (truth) with its term, canonical form, Gödel numbers and proof obligations; every implementation is an action linked to it by a witness or proof; identities are transformations; procedures are methods with their limits.
usefulness: Every piece of code knows what it means, and every claim knows its evidence.
